invariant: USymbolNode.drawNode draws a polygon whose horizontal points span 0 through width and a UEmpty(10,10) translated to (0,height). LimitFinder.drawUPolygon expands the polygon minimum and maximum by exactly ten pixels on x, while drawEmpty contributes x=0 and x=10. The painted node frontier is therefore [-10,width+10] horizontally and [0,height+10] vertically. SvekResult calculates one global MinMax from those primitives, translates its minimum to the SVEK margin, and sizes the canvas from the translated maximum.
causal_divergence: Rust correctly normalizes the node cluster minimum from x-10, but package_cluster_envelope_extra extends its maximum by 20 pixels. The constant's existing comment incorrectly describes the lower UEmpty as lower-right; Java translates it to x=0. When a node cluster owns the right envelope, Rust consequently emits an otherwise byte-equivalent diagram in a canvas exactly ten pixels wider than Java. Three independent top-to-bottom checker inputs expose the same isolated 10px SVG-width surplus, while cases where another primitive owns the maximum already pass.
planned_change: Model the node cluster's right LimitFinder frontier as width+10 and retain the existing bottom frontier as height+10. Correct the adjacent Java provenance comment. Do not alter cluster geometry, layout positions, painted-min normalization, direction handling, or the common canvas padding.
